requirements.text: The OBU shall establish a communication session in each of the trigger situations defined in SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4, among them Start of Mission, an order from trackside, a mode change to be reported to the RBC, a manual level change to Level 2, the engine rear end leaving an announced radio hole and loss of the safe radio connection, observing the Level 2 restrictions stated there for individual triggers.
requirements.method_rationale: SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te yok ve SUBSET-076-5-2'de resmî test vakası var: Test.
requirements.note: h) maddesindeki seviye koşulu kaynak metnin kendisinde eksik ("only if level"); cümle bu koşulu ayrıca belirtmiyor, sekiz tetikleyici standartta kalıyor.
requirements.reference_preconditions: Level 2 (or, for the manual level change, level 0/NTC/1 with level 2 in the table of trackside supported levels), train in a normal operating mode, no communication session established, mobile terminal registered to a radio network, driver ID valid; RBC contact information stored except in the driver-entry scenario.

reference_checks.action: Level 2, no communication session established: a mode change occurs that has to be reported to the RBC (not an End of Mission and not the completion of a Start of Mission).
reference_checks.expected: The OBU starts establishing a communication session with the RBC by requesting the set-up of a safe radio connection.
reference_checks.channel_note: Official test 3050300/TC30 (3.5.3.4 c): RTM SA-CONNECT.Request transmitted; trackside never confirms, so the remainder of the test (repetition of attempts, connection-status indication) verifies 3.5.3.7 a) and 3.5.7.5.

basis.text: Setting up a safe connection to report a mode change is unsuccessful. … A mode change, which has to be reported to the RBC as of 3.5.3.4 c), has just occured. … SA-CONNECT.Request is transmitted … First attempt.

reference_checks.action: Train at standstill in level 0, NTC or level 1 after Start of Mission, valid RBC contact information and a mobile terminal registered to a radio network; the driver manually selects level 2.
reference_checks.expected: Immediately after the level change to 2, the OBU establishes a communication session with the RBC (requests a safe radio connection and, once connected, sends the session initiation to the RBC).
reference_checks.channel_note: Official test 5100315/TC2 (3.5.3.4 d): RTM SA-CONNECT.Request, then SA-DATA.Request with message 155 'Initiation of a communication session' after SA-CONNECT.Confirm; JRU MESSAGE TO RBC (NID_MESSAGE_JRU=10).

reference_checks.action: Level 2, outside the Start of Mission procedure, no communication session and no valid RBC contact information stored; the driver enters and confirms RBC contact information (RBC identity and phone number).
reference_checks.expected: The OBU establishes a communication session with the RBC given by the driver (requests a safe radio connection and, once connected, sends the session initiation).
reference_checks.channel_note: Official test 5100315/TC3 (3.5.3.4 h): driver uses the Radio data window; JRU RBC CONTACT INFORMATION ENTERED BY THE DRIVER (NID_MESSAGE_JRU=24, Q_RBCENTRY=2); RTM SA-CONNECT.Request, then message 155 after SA-CONNECT.Confirm.

support_passages.text: 3.5.3.4 The on-board shall establish a communication session a) At Start of Mission (only if level 2). b) If ordered from trackside. c) If a mode change, neither considered as an End of Mission nor triggered from condition g) below, has to be reported to the RBC (only if level 2) d) If the driver has manually changed the level to 2 e) When the engine rear end reaches the end of an announced radio hole f) When the previous communication session is considered as terminated due to loss of safe radio connection (refer to 3.5.4.2.1) g) When a Start of Mission procedure, during which no communication session could be established, is completed in level 2 h) When outside the Start of Mission procedure, the driver has manually selected the RBC contact information (only if level)

requirements.reference_note: Three test cases. Kept 3 checks, one per exercised trigger: c) mode change to be reported (3050300/TC30), d) manual level change to 2 (5100315/TC2), h) driver-entered RBC contact information outside SoM (5100315/TC3). Dropped 34 steps: TC30 steps 2-12 (retries limited to the configured number of attempts and DMI/JRU connection status: 3.5.3.7 a), A.3.1, 3.5.7.5); TC2 steps 2-3 (level symbol: 5.10.3.15), 5 and 7-13 (session establishment message exchange: 3.5.3.7); TC3 steps 1-2, 4, 6 and 8-16 (radio data entry, message exchange: 5.10.3.15.2, 3.5.3.7). Triggers a), b), e), f), g) and the Level 2 restrictions are not exercised by the supplied blocks (candidate 3180400/TC12 has no block). Trigger h) is not named in the requirement sentence, so that check needs the document. Minor imprecision: the requirement names 'loss of the safe radio connection' as trigger, whereas f) triggers only when the previous session is considered terminated due to that loss (3.5.4.2.1); not exercised here.

requirements.text: The OBU shall not open a further communication session with an RBC/RIU while a session with that same RBC/RIU is still being established, or is established and no Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to it. This applies to sessions triggered by: Start of Mission in Level 2; an order from trackside; a Level 2 mode change to be reported to the RBC (except End of Mission, and except completion in Level 2 of a Start of Mission during which no session could be established); a manual level change to Level 2 by the driver; the engine rear end reaching the end of an announced radio hole; or manual selection of RBC contact information by the driver outside Start of Mission (SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4.1).
requirements.method_rationale: SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te yok ve SUBSET-076-5-2'de resmî test vakası var: Test.
requirements.note: Tetikleyici adları 3.5.3.4'ten açık yazıldı; h) için seviye koşulu kaynakta eksik olduğundan yazılmadı.
requirements.reference_preconditions: Level 2, train in a mode such as FS, OS, SR, SB, TR, PT, NL, LS or AD. A communication session with the RBC is established (safe radio connection connected) and no Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to that RBC. A radio hole has been announced by the RBC (track condition 'radio hole').

reference_checks.action: While a communication session with the RBC is still established and no Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to it, the train reaches the end of an announced radio hole (trigger 'end of radio hole' for establishing a session).
reference_checks.expected: The OBU does not establish a new communication session with that RBC: it neither requests a new safe radio connection nor sends an Initiation of communication session; the existing session stays established.
reference_checks.channel_note: Official test: radio hole announced in General message M24 with packet 68 (M_TRACKCOND=0100); end of radio hole reached with the estimated front end within 5 minutes; RTM: NOT SA-CONNECT.Request, NOT M155, NOT M159; JRU MESSAGE FROM RBC (NID_MESSAGE_JRU=9).

basis.text: The train reaches a location with its estimated … The train front reaches the end of the … announced radio hole while the … NOT SA-CONNECT.Request is transmitted … No new communication session is … established because another session is … already established and no Termination of … "Initiation of a communication session"

support_passages.text: 3.5.3.4 The on-board shall establish a communication session a) At Start of Mission (only if level 2). b) If ordered from trackside. c) If a mode change, neither considered as an End of Mission nor triggered from condition g) below, has to be reported to the RBC (only if level 2) d) If the driver has manually changed the level to 2 e) When the engine rear end reaches the end of an announced radio hole f) When the previous communication session is considered as terminated due to loss of safe radio connection (refer to 3.5.4.2.1) g) When a Start of Mission procedure, during which no communication session could be established, is completed in level 2 h) When outside the Start of Mission procedure, the driver has manually selected the RBC contact information (only if level)

3.5.3.4.1 In respect of a), b), c), d), e) and h) of 3.5.3.4, the on-board shall not establish a new communication session with an RBC/RIU in case a communication session: • is currently being established with this RBC/RIU or • is already established with this RBC/RIU and no Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to this RBC/RIU.

requirements.reference_note: Only test case 3050300/TC18 (trigger e, end of radio hole, session already established). Dropped 2 steps: radio hole announcement and its JRU recording (set-up). The official test moves the estimated front end to the end of the radio hole while the clause 3.5.3.4 e) speaks of the engine rear end; the requirement follows the clause. The 'currently being established' branch and the other triggers are not covered by the official test.

requirements.text: When the OBU has to establish a communication session with an RBC while in session with one or more other RBCs, it shall terminate the existing session(s) (as per SUBSET-026 §3.5.5.2) and establish the new one. Exception: an order to establish a session with an Accepting RBC that is embedded in an RBC transition order shall not cause the session with the currently supervising RBC to be terminated, unless the OBU can handle only one communication session through GSM-R and a session must be established with another RBC, in which case the existing session is terminated (SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.5.2, §3.5.3.5.2.1).
requirements.method_rationale: SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te yok ve SUBSET-076-5-2'de resmî test vakası var: Test.
requirements.note: srs_text'te olmayan 3.5.3.5.2.1 istisnası metne eklendi; tek GSM-R oturumu durumunun ayrıntısı 3.15.1.3.2.4'te.
requirements.reference_preconditions: Level 0/NTC/1/2 in a mode such as FS, OS, SR, SB or SL; a communication session is established with RBC A (safe radio connection to RBC A up) and not with RBC B; no RBC/RBC handover is in progress.

reference_checks.action: While in session with RBC A, the OBU receives and accepts an order to establish a communication session with another RBC (RBC B), not embedded in an RBC transition order
reference_checks.expected: The OBU terminates the existing communication session with RBC A
reference_checks.channel_note: Official test: order via balise packet 42 (Q_RBC=1); RTM: M156 to RBC A, M39 from RBC A, SA-DISCONNECT.Request to RBC A (steps 3-7).

support_passages.text: 3.5.3.5.2 If the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment has to establish a communication session with an RBC whilst in session with one or more other RBC(s), the existing communication session(s) shall be terminated (see 3.5.5.2 for details) and the new one shall be established.

3.5.5.2 In case a session is established, the on-board equipment shall terminate the communication session according to the following steps: a) The on-board equipment shall send a Termination of communication session message.

requirements.reference_note: Official test 3050300/TC2 covers only the main rule (3.5.3.5.2); the exception for an Accepting RBC session ordered within an RBC transition order (3.5.3.5.2.1) has no official step, so no check for it. Dropped 0 steps of other clauses; JRU recording steps and the optional DMI connection symbol and train data/position report steps after establishment are not checks.

requirements.text: The OBU shall establish a communication session as sequenced in SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.7: request safe radio connection set-up, repeating it immediately on each failure (bounded per Appendix A.3.1 only during Start of Mission or for a mode-change report), send Initiation of communication session and, on receipt of the system version, consider the session established and send a session established report or, if no version is compatible, send "No compatible version supported", inform the driver and terminate the session.
requirements.method_rationale: SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te yok ve SUBSET-076-5-2'de resmî test vakası var: Test.
requirements.note: c) ve e) adımları yerden tarafın davranışı, cümleye alınmadı; srs_text Şekil 3 artıkları içeriyor; 3.5.3.7.1–3.5.3.7.5 istisnaları ayrı maddelerde.
requirements.reference_preconditions: Level 2 (or level 1/2 for the trackside-ordered case), train in a supervised mode (e.g. FS, OS, SR, LS, AD), train data stored, no communication session established and no safe radio connection set up. For the bounded-retry case a mode change that must be reported to the RBC has just occurred.

reference_checks.action: A communication session has to be established outside Start of Mission and not for a mode-change report (e.g. ordered by trackside); the OBU starts the establishment.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU requests the set-up of a safe radio connection with the trackside (RBC).
reference_checks.channel_note: Step a). RTM: SA-CONNECT.Request. Official test orders the session with a balise group message containing packet 42 (session management) in L1/L2.

basis.text: SA-CONNECT.Request is transmitted O RTM with the phone number included in the … session management packet.

reference_checks.action: A mode change that has to be reported to the RBC occurs in level 2 with no session; the safe radio connection set-up fails (EURORADIO indicates failure).
reference_checks.expected: The OBU repeats the request to set up the safe radio connection immediately after each failure indication.
reference_checks.channel_note: Step a). RTM: SA-CONNECT.Request repeated (second, third attempt) after the EURORADIO connection establishment timer (40 s) expires without SA-CONNECT.Confirm.

reference_checks.expected: After the defined number of unsuccessful attempts (3), the OBU makes no further attempt to set up the safe radio connection.
reference_checks.channel_note: Step a), bound from A.3.1 (3 times). RTM: no fourth SA-CONNECT.Request.

reference_checks.expected: The OBU sends the message Initiation of communication session to the RBC.

support_passages.text: 3.5.3.7 The establishment of a communication session shall be performed according to the following steps: a) The on-board shall request the set-up of a safe radio connection with the trackside. If this request is part of an ongoing Start of Mission procedure or is related to the establishment of a communication session due to condition 3.5.3.4 c), it shall be repeated until successful or a defined number of times (see Appendix A.3.1). If this request is not part of an ongoing Start of Mission procedure and is not related to the establishment of a communication session due to condition 3.5.3.4 c), it shall be repeated until successful. A request shall be repeated immediately after EURORADIO has indicated that setting up the safe radio connection has failed.
b) As soon as the safe radio connection is set-up, the on-board shall send the message Initiation of communication session to the trackside.
A.3.1 List of Fixed Value Data Fixed Value Data Value Name The number of times to try to establish a safe radio 3 times connection.

3.5.3.4 The on-board shall establish a communication session a) At Start of Mission (only if level 2). b) If ordered from trackside. c) If a mode change, neither considered as an End of Mission nor triggered from condition g) below, has to be reported to the RBC (only if level 2)

requirements.reference_note: Dropped 9 steps: 3050300/TC30 steps 4-6 and 11-12 (DMI/JRU 'connection lost/set-up failed' status symbol, other clauses); 3180400/TC12 steps 1-3 and 7 (balise order and use of the RBC contact information, 3.5.3.4 b / 3.18.4.3.1, and JRU recordings). Steps d) of 3.5.3.7 (reception of the system version, session established report, 'No compatible version supported' with driver information and termination) are not exercised by the official blocks; no checks written for them. No requirement defect found; the requirement correctly leaves out trackside steps c) and e).

requirements.text: When both radio systems are fitted, the OBU shall select the radio system for requesting the safe radio connection set-up according to the priority order of SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.7.1: first a trackside order (depending on whether the target RBC is FRMCS-only), then the driver's single-radio choice at Start of Mission, then the stored Radio Network information and preferred radio system.
requirements.method_rationale: SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te kısmen test edilebilir olarak listeli; test edilebilen kısım Test, kalanı Analiz.
requirements.note: Kaynak metnin 1) maddesi seçilecek radyo sistemini açıkça söylemiyor; tercih edilen sistem ayrıntısı SUBSET-037-1'de.
requirements.reference_preconditions: Level 2 (or a session with an RBC to be opened), OBU fitted with both FRMCS on-board equipment and a GSM-R Mobile Terminal, both available; RBC contact information valid; Radio Network information stored as given per check.

reference_checks.action: Both radio systems (FRMCS and GSM-R) are installed; the stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R with GSM-R stored as preferred radio system; the OBU receives a trackside order to contact an RBC that is interfaced with FRMCS only, and must set up the safe radio connection to it.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU requests the safe radio connection set-up through the FRMCS on-board equipment (the trackside order takes priority over the stored preferred radio system).
reference_checks.channel_note: Observable on the Euroradio/radio interface (which mobile equipment issues the connection request); needs a bench with both FRMCS and GSM-R on-board radio equipment. Trackside order e.g. packet 32 'Session Management for RBC interfaced to FRMCS only' (or packet 31 for an RBC transition).

reference_checks.action: Both radio systems installed, stored Radio Network type FRMCS+GSM-R; during Start of Mission the driver elects to perform the mission with only one radio system, and registration succeeded only with one of them (e.g. the GSM-R Mobile Terminal); no trackside order is pending.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU requests the safe radio connection set-up only through the radio system to which registration was successful during the SoM (here the GSM-R Mobile Terminal).
reference_checks.channel_note: Driver selection in the SoM single-radio dialogue (SUBSET-026-5 S5); observable on the radio interface.

reference_checks.action: Both radio systems installed, stored Radio Network type FRMCS+GSM-R, a preferred radio system stored from the previous communication session with the RBC and available; no trackside order and no single-radio election by the driver.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU requests the safe radio connection set-up through the stored preferred radio system.
reference_checks.channel_note: Preferred radio system as stored when the previous session was established; see SUBSET-037-1 for details. Observable on the radio interface.

support_passages.text: 3.5.3.7.1 Regarding a), if both radio systems are installed on-board it shall request the set-up of a safe radio connection according to the following (by priority order): 1) In case of order received from trackside, depending on whether the order relates to an RBC interfaced with FRMCS only, OR 2) If the stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R and if during the SoM the driver has elected to perform the mission with only one radio system, by using either the FRMCS on-board equipment or a GSM-R Mobile Terminal, depending on the radio system to which the registration was successful during the SoM, OR

3) According to the stored Radio Network information (Radio Network type and, if relevant, GSM-R Radio Network ID). If the Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM- R, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board shall use, if available, the preferred radio system stored when establishing the previous communication session with the RBC (see SUBSET-037-1 for details)
7.4.2.7.2 Packet Number 32: Session Management for RBC interfaced to FRMCS only Description Packet to give the identity of the RBC with which a session shall be established or terminated.

requirements.reference_note: No official test (SUBSET-076-7 Table 3 lists 3.5.3.7.1 as not/partially testable on a bench); checks written from the clause and observable only on a bench fitted with both radio systems. The first check's outcome (FRMCS used for an FRMCS-only RBC) is inferred from the order's name; no corpus text states which radio system each order case selects (details deferred to SUBSET-037-1, whose corpus copy does not cover it), hence not_in_corpus. Defect/ambiguity: item 1) of the clause (and the requirement) does not say which radio system is used when the trackside order does NOT relate to an FRMCS-only RBC; only the FRMCS-only case is checked. The requirement's 'driver's single-radio choice' omits the clause condition that the stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R and that the system used is the one to which registration succeeded during SoM.

requirements.text: When both radio systems are fitted, the OBU shall memorise which radio system it used to successfully set up the safe radio connection when establishing a communication session.
requirements.method_rationale: SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te kısmen test edilebilir olarak listeli; test edilebilen kısım Test, kalanı Analiz.
requirements.note: Saklanan bilgi doğrudan gözlenemez; etkisi ancak sonraki oturum kurulumunda (3.5.3.7.1 3)) dolaylı görülür.
requirements.reference_preconditions: Level 1 (official test) with an established communication session with an RIU, train in FS, OS, SR, LS or AD, safe radio connection set up; both radio systems (GSM-R and FRMCS) fitted on-board for the kept check.

reference_checks.action: Both radio systems are fitted and a safe radio connection was successfully set up over one of them when a communication session was established; the OBU next has to set up a safe radio connection again (official example: reconnection after loss of the safe radio connection without a disconnection order).
reference_checks.expected: The OBU requests the new safe radio connection over the radio system through which the previous safe radio connection had been successfully set up (the memorised radio system).
reference_checks.channel_note: Official test: level 1 with RIU session, RTM SA-DISCONNECT.Indication (loss), then SA-CONNECT.Request; the radio system used is observed only if both radio systems are installed (step 4 comment). The memorised value itself is not observable on any interface; only its use is.

basis.text: SA-DISCONNECT.Indication is received … Loss of the safe radio connection. … SA-CONNECT.Request is transmitted … If both radio systems are installed on- … board, check that the radio system used is … the same through which the safe radio … connection was successfully set up

support_passages.text: 3.5.3.7.2 Regarding b), if both radio systems are installed on-board it shall store the radio system through which the safe radio connection is successfully set up.

3.5.4.2 When EURORADIO indicates the loss of the safe radio connection, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall immediately try to set-up a new safe radio connection using the radio system through which the safe radio connection was successfully set up beforehand (see SUBSET-037-1 for details).

3) According to the stored Radio Network information (Radio Network type and, if relevant, GSM-R Radio Network ID). If the Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM- R, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board shall use, if available, the preferred radio system stored when establishing the previous communication session with the RBC (see SUBSET-037-1 for details)

requirements.reference_note: One test case (3050400/TC1), shared with ETC-011; it lists 3.5.3.7.2 among its bases. The stored radio system cannot be read on any interface (non-testable stratum); the only observable effect in the block is step 4, where the reconnection attempt after loss of the safe radio connection must use the radio system through which the connection was set up beforehand (use of the stored value, required by 3.5.4.2; at a new session set-up the stored preferred system is used per 3.5.3.7.1 item 3, not exercised here). Kept that one check; needs_documents because the observable use is defined in 3.5.4.2, not in the requirement sentence. Dropped 16 steps: 1-2 (RIU terminate order, JRU), 5-7, 10-14, 17-18 (repetition and stop of attempts: 3.5.4.3), 8-9, 15-16 (connection status DMI/JRU: 3.5.7.5). No requirement defect.

requirements.text: While a communication session is being established (from the first request to set up the safe radio connection until the system version is received), the OBU shall abort it and release any safe radio connection when any condition of SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.8 occurs, e.g. desk closure during Start of Mission, End of Mission, a trackside termination order, or the min safe rear end passing a Level 2 exit or RBC/RBC border.
requirements.method_rationale: SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te yok ve SUBSET-076-5-2'de resmî test vakası var: Test.
requirements.note: Dokuz koşul (a–i) standartta bırakıldı; her koşul ve oturum kurulumunun farklı adımları için ayrı test gerekir.
requirements.reference_preconditions: Train running (not at standstill) in Level 2 (or Level 1 for the RIU case) in FS, OS, SR, LS or AD, with no active communication session. The OBU has received an order to establish a session (with an RBC, or with an RIU at a radio infill area) and keeps repeating safe radio connection set-up requests that do not succeed. Only one GSM-R mobile terminal is available on board.

reference_checks.action: While the OBU is still trying to set up the safe radio connection for a session with RBC X (session being established, outside Start of Mission), the train passes an RBC/RBC border with its min safe rear end.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU aborts the establishment of the session with RBC X: it stops requesting set-up of the safe radio connection to RBC X.
reference_checks.channel_note: Official test: session order by balise packet 42 (NID_RBC=1515), RBC transition order packet 131 (NID_RBC=1616); RTM SA-CONNECT.Request repeated >45 s and at least 4 times, then NOT SA-CONNECT.Request to NID_RBC 1515. The following connection attempt to the new RBC Y belongs to the RBC transition clauses.

reference_checks.action: While the OBU is still trying to set up the safe radio connection for a session with an RBC, the engine front end passes the start of an announced radio hole.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU aborts the establishment of the session: it stops requesting set-up of the safe radio connection to that RBC.

DMI 'Safe radio connection - Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' symbol removal belongs to other clauses.

basis.text: The engine front end passes the area of … an announced radio hole and the on-board … stops trying set up a save connection to … NOT SA-CONNECT.Request is transmitted … Train stops trying set up a save radio

support_passages.text: 3.5.3.8 When a communication session is currently being established (i.e. at any time from the first request the set-up of a safe radio connection to the reception of the system version from trackside), the on-board shall no longer apply 3.5.3.7 a), 3.5.3.7 b) and 3.5.3.7 d) (i.e. it aborts the process of establishing it) and shall release the safe radio connection (if any) if at least one of the following conditions is met: a) The driver closes the desk during Start of Mission b) End of Mission is performed c) An order to terminate the communication session is received from trackside d) The train passes with its min safe rear end a level transition border from a level 2 area to an area where level 2 operation is not supported

e) An order to establish a communication session with a different RBC is received from trackside and the order does not request to contact an Accepting RBC f) The train passes an RBC/RBC border with its min safe rear end g) The engine front end passes the start of an announced radio hole h) Regards RIUs only: Level 1 is left i) The driver elects to modify the Radio Network type or the GSM-R Radio Network ID

3.5.3.4 The on-board shall establish a communication session a) At Start of Mission (only if level 2). b) If ordered from trackside. c) If a mode change, neither considered as an End of Mission nor triggered from condition g) below, has to be reported to the RBC (only if level 2) d) If the driver has manually changed the level to 2 e) When the engine rear end reaches the end of an announced radio hole f) When the previous communication session is considered as terminated due to loss of safe radio connection (refer to 3.5.4.2.1) g) When a Start of Mission procedure, during which no communication session could be established, is completed in level 2 h) When outside the Start of Mission procedure, the driver has manually selected the RBC contact information (only if level)

3.5.3.7 The establishment of a communication session shall be performed according to the following steps: a) The on-board shall request the set-up of a safe radio connection with the trackside. If this request is part of an ongoing Start of Mission procedure or is related to the establishment of a communication session due to condition 3.5.3.4 c), it shall be repeated until successful or a defined number of times (see Appendix A.3.1). If this request is not part of an ongoing Start of Mission procedure and is not related to the establishment of a communication session due to condition 3.5.3.4 c), it shall be repeated until successful. A request shall be repeated immediately after EURORADIO has indicated that setting up the safe radio connection has failed.

3.5.7.5 The ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall execute the transitions between the different indication statuses of the safe radio connection with the relevant RBC/RIU as described in Table 1 according to the conditions in Table 2 (see section 4.6.1 for details about the symbols). No <3 < 5, 6, 7 Connection -p2- -p1- Connection 1, 2 > <2 Lost / -p2- -p2- Set-Up failed 4> 4> Connection -p1- -p1- Up Table 1: Transitions between the indication statuses of the safe radio connection

Condition Content of the conditions Id [1] (a Start of mission procedure is ongoing) AND (the final attempt to set-up the safe radio connection failed) [2] (the “connection status” timer expires) [3] (no Start of mission procedure is ongoing) AND (the requests to set-up a safe radio connection are stopped with the relevant RBC/RIU for reason other than the successful set-up) [4] (the safe radio connection is set-up) [5] (the safe radio connection is released) [6] (the safe radio connection is lost) AND (the requests to set-up a safe radio connection are stopped with the relevant RBC/RIU for reason other than the successful set-up) [7] (the safe radio connection is lost) AND (the engine, taking into account its front and rear ends, overlaps an announced radio hole) Table 2: Transition conditions for the indication statuses of the safe radio connection

8.4.1.3 When the indication status for the safe radio connection is “Connection Up”, the symbol ST03 shall be displayed in E1. 8.4.1.4 When the indication status for the safe radio connection is “No Connection”, no symbol shall be displayed in E1. 8.4.1.5 When the indication status for the safe radio connection is “Connection Lost/Set-Up failed”, the symbol ST04 shall be displayed in E1.

requirements.text: The OBU shall take the side of the active cab as the front of the train when defining train orientation and, when no cab is active, shall define the orientation by the last active cab.

reference_checks.expected: The OBU keeps the orientation defined by the last active cab: the train orientation relative to the LRBG is still nominal.

support_passages.text: 3.6.1.5 If there is an active cab, this one defines the orientation of the train, i.e. the side of the active cab shall be considered as determining the front of the train. If no cab is active, the train orientation shall be defined by the last active cab.

7.5.1.104 Q_DIRLRBG Name Orientation of the train in relation to the direction of the LRBG Description Length of variable Minimum Value Maximum Value Resolution/formula 2 bits Special/Reserved Values 0 Reverse 1 Nominal 2 Unknown

requirements.reference_note: Dropped 0 steps beyond the JRU-only observation rows, which are used as outcome evidence in channel_note. The official test does not cover a change of active cab (e.g. the other cab becoming active, giving a reverse orientation), so it does not show that the orientation follows the cab. requirements.reference_preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, OS, LS or AD, communication session with the RBC, a level 2 transition order stored on board and linking information stored for the current area.

reference_checks.action: Level 1 with a level 2 transition order stored. Linking information received by radio is held in the transition buffer; it refers to an earlier balise group (FRBG) and does not announce the balise group BGx that the train passes next, which becomes LRBG and SOLR. At the level 2 border the buffered linking information is released and applied.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU sets the SOLR back to the reference balise group of the released linking information (FRBG), while BGx remains the LRBG; i.e. the stored linking is replaced first (3.7.3.1 m) and the SOLR is then re-determined from it.
reference_checks.channel_note: Official test: message 24 with packet 5 (linking, referred to FRBG, Q_LINK=1) received in L1; balise group BGx with Q_LINK=1 and packet 255; level transition to L2 at the stored location. Observed through JRU NID_SOLR changing from BGx to FRBG (NID_MESSAGE_JRU=ALL). Modes FS, AD, LS, OS merged.

support_passages.text: 3.6.4.2.2.2 Whenever linking information is received (e.g. when it is released from the transition buffer), the clause 3.7.3.1 m) shall be applied before this clause 3.6.4.2.2. For all other information, any relocation to the SOLR resulting from this clause 3.6.4.2.2 shall take place before the corresponding item of the clause 3.7.3.1 is applied.

3.6.4.2.2 The Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR) shall be: a) the last received balise group that is the reference of linking information or that is announced in linking information (including if it is announced with a balise group with ID “unknown” and it contains repositioning information), while the linking consistency is checked (see 3.4.4.2.1.1), or b) the last received balise group, while no linking consistency is checked.
m) New linking information received as non-infill information shall replace all stored linking information from the reference balise group of the new linking information.

3.6.4.2.2.3 Note: the SOLR is generally equal to the LRBGONB. For some cases however, like the transition to level 1/2 area, it might be possible that the linking information released from the transition buffer provokes the change of SOLR to a former LRBG in case this information does not announce every balise group in rear of the border (see Figure 13e).

requirements.reference_note: Dropped 5 steps: step 2 and 4 (JRU recordings of the received messages), step 5 (BGx becomes SOLR on passage, 3.6.4.2.2 b), steps 6-8 (reaching the border, level 2 symbol and its JRU record; level transition clauses). The second sentence of the requirement ('for all other information' the relocation to the SOLR comes before the replacement rule) is not exercised by the official block. No requirement defect found. The ordering is internal and can be observed only through the resulting SOLR.

requirements.text: The OBU shall process each location based information into up to three location items ("min", "estimated", "max") and, wherever SUBSET-026 Table 2a associates a clause with a type of location item for that information, shall apply that clause using the corresponding location item.

requirements.reference_preconditions: Train running in FS, OS or AD (SM also for the radio case) with valid position and linking stored. Radio case: level 2, session established, MA stored, linking includes BGx and BGy. Transition-buffer cases: level 2 (SSP case, transition to level 1 announced) or level 1 (axle load case, transition to level 2 announced, axle load speed profile forming the MRSP); BG1 is the last balise group announced by linking; train speed below the speed limits involved; no TSR.

reference_checks.action: Linking information covering balise groups BGx and BGy is stored; the train passes BGx and then BGy (both linked; BGy becomes the SOLR), the actual travelled distance between them differing from the linking distance. The RBC then sends a static speed profile with a speed increase whose location is referred to BGx (a balise group other than the SOLR).
reference_checks.expected: The OBU relocates the speed increase to BGy using the linking distance between BGx and BGy (not the travelled distance): the higher permitted speed applies when the min safe front end reaches the location (distance from BGx minus the linking distance BGx-BGy) counted from BGy.

c) in all other cases, the estimated, min or max travelled distance between the FRBG and the SOLR, computed as per clauses 3.6.1.3 and 3.6.4.1.5 from train front end positions in reference to FRBG and to SOLR, as follows: • (estimated front end position against FRBG – estimated front end position against SOLR) for "estimated" location items, • (min safe front end position against FRBG – min safe front end position against SOLR) for "min" location items, • (max safe front end position against FRBG – max safe front end position against SOLR) for "max" location items.

requirements.reference_note: Three test cases. Kept 3 checks: relocation with the linking distance for RBC data referred to a non-SOLR balise group (3060400/TC2, case a), relocation with the max and min travelled distance of buffered data when the linking distance is unknown (3110300/TC8 and 3110400/TC5, case c). Dropped 25 steps: JRU-only records and SOLR/LRBG JRU confirmations (3060400/TC2 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 13; 3110300/TC8 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 14; 3110400/TC5 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 10, 12, 16), optional OS driver request for speed display (TC8 4, TC5 4: 4.4.12.1.4), position reports (3060400/TC2 3, 7: 3.6.2.2.2); remaining inputs are folded into the actions, and the comments of TC8 step 11 and TC5 step 13 (relocation case) are quoted in basis. Case b) (relocation after a previous case c relocation, with location accuracy adjustments) is not exercised. Note: the official tests show that buffered information is not relocated when an unlinked balise group becomes the SOLR, but only when evaluated; the requirement (like the clause) says 'every location item' whenever a balise group becomes the SOLR, which a reader may take literally. Table 2a min/max classification is needed and is laid out as a table in the corpus. No requirement defect.

requirements.text: The OBU shall send position reports to the RBC as requested in the position report parameters and, in addition, whenever any of the events of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.4 occurs, among them reaching or leaving standstill, a mode or level change, train integrity confirmation or loss, crossing an RBC/RBC border, session establishment, and passing an LRBG compliant balise group when no parameters are stored.

requirements.reference_preconditions: Level 2 (the official test allows any level/mode), communication session with the RBC established, no position report parameters stored. Stored linking information (consistency checked) does not contain the balise group about to be passed; no other reporting event occurs at that location.

reference_checks.action: With no position report parameters stored, the train passes a balise group marked as linked that is not contained in the stored linking information (i.e. not LRBG compliant), and no other reporting event occurs.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU sends no position report on passing that balise group.
reference_checks.channel_note: Official test 3060500/TC12: balise group message (Q_LINK=1) with packet 255, BG not in linking; RTM NOT M136 (packet 0/1).

basis.text: The train overpasses a balise group not … included in the linking info. … NO Train Position Report is SENT.

support_passages.text: 3.6.5.1.4 The on-board equipment shall send position reports as requested by the RBC in the position report parameters. In addition, it shall also send a position report if at least one of the events listed hereafter occurs: a) The train reaches standstill. b) The mode changes. c) The driver confirms train integrity. d) A loss of train integrity is detected. e) The train passes an RBC/RBC border with its min safe rear end. f) The train passes with its min safe rear end a level transition border which led to a transition from level 2 to level 0, NTC or 1. g) The level changes. h) A communication session is successfully established. i) The train leaves standstill. j) The train passes an LRBG compliant balise group (see 3.6.2.2.2 a)), if no position report parameters are stored on-board.

3.6.2.2.2 For the LRBG the following requirements have to be met: a) The on-board equipment shall use as a reference for reporting the train position to the RBC the last passed LRBG compliant balise group that fulfils the conditions of the clause 3.6.5.1.8. This balise group is termed as LRBGONB in the following. Only • balise groups marked as linked and contained in the previously received linking information, if linking consistency is checked on-board or • balise groups not marked as unlinked, if linking consistency was not checked when such a balise group was passed shall be regarded as LRBG compliant balise groups.

requirements.reference_note: Kept one check (3060500/TC12, event j) negative: a balise group that is not LRBG compliant does not trigger a report; 'LRBG compliant' needs 3.6.2.2.2 a)). Dropped 3060500/TC50 and TC51 entirely (12 steps) and 2 JRU steps: they check that in Sleeping/Stand-By without an established session no position report is sent and no session is set up at an RBC/RBC border or an LRBG compliant balise group, which follows from SUBSET-026-4 4.5.2 table note {5} ('Only if a radio communication session is already established'), not from the requirement. Defect: the requirement (like the clause) omits this Sleeping/Stand-By restriction, so a test written from its plain reading would expect reports there. The positive cases (a report for each listed event) have no official test in this set.

requirements.text: The OBU shall display the geographical position, in relation to the track kilometre, of the train's estimated front end only when the driver requests it, and shall stop that display upon driver request.
requirements.method_rationale: SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te yok ve SUBSET-076-5-2'de resmî test vakası var: Test.
requirements.reference_preconditions: Any level (0, 1, 2) and a mode in which the geographical position can be shown (e.g. FS, OS, SR, SB, UN, LS, AD, TR, PT, NL, SM); geographical position information received from trackside and stored, referring to a balise group not yet passed at reception; the display is not shown.

reference_checks.action: Geographical position information is stored on-board and the train has passed its reference balise group (and offset); the driver requests the geographical position display.

requirements.text: The OBU shall keep applying the MA request parameters last received from the RBC (whether MA requests are to be repeated and, if so, the time between repetitions, and the triggering time criteria for MA requests related to the perturbation location and to MA timer elapsing) until new MA request parameters are received from the RBC, which then replace them at once. 3.8.2.1.1 The on-board equipment may request a new Movement Authority from the RBC for the following reasons: a) “Start” selection by the driver (only level 2) b) With respect to perturbation location (only level 2) c) With respect to MA timer elapsing (only level 2) d) Track description deletion (only level 2) e) Reception of "track ahead free up to the level 2 transition location"

a) A defined time before the train reaches the perturbation location assuming it is running at the warning speed (see section 3.13.11 for details). b) A defined time before the Section timer (not the End Section timer, not the Overlap timer) for any section of the MA expires, or before the LOA speed timer expires. 3.8.2.2.2 With regard to the above possibilities, the MA request shall be triggered when the train front has passed the location defined by 3.8.2.2.1 a) / when the moment defined by 3.8.2.2.1 b) is reached. 3.8.2.2.3 Once the resulting location regarding 3.8.2.2.1 a) is passed by the train front, the reason "Time before reaching the perturbation location reached" shall remain applicable until the triggering criterion is not fulfilled anymore, e.g. due to the reception of a new MA or to a temporary EOA that is no longer supervised.

support_passages.text: 3.8.6.1 It shall be possible to shorten a given MA using a special procedure between on-board equipment and RBC. The procedure is as follows: a) The RBC sends a request to shorten MA, which includes a proposed shortened MA with an EOA closer to the train than the current EOA/LOA, optionally with a mode profile and in case of SH mode profile optionally with a list of balise groups for SH area.

b) The ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall check the train front end position versus the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA. • If it is in rear, the request shall be accepted and the on-board equipment shall consider the proposed shortened MA as the new MA, together with its accompanying mode profile (if any) and list of balise groups for SH area (if any). • If it is in advance, the request shall be rejected and the previously received MA, mode profile (if any) and list of balise groups for SH area (if any) shall remain valid c) The RBC shall be informed about the decision.

support_passages.text: 3.11.8.1 It shall be possible to define the maximum train speed related to the actual performance and configuration of the train.

3.11.2.2 There are eleven categories of Static Speed Restrictions: a) Static Speed Profile (SSP) b) Axle load Speed Profile (ASP) c) Temporary Speed Restrictions (TSR) d) Maximum Train Speed e) Signalling related speed restriction (only level 1) f) Mode related Speed Restriction.
3.13.2.2.13.1 The speed and distance monitoring shall take into account the maximum train speed defined as part of Train Data (see section 3.18.3).

3.13.7.2 The Most Restrictive Speed Profile shall be derived from elements corresponding to all speed restrictions (see 3.13.2.2.13 & 3.13.2.3.2), some elements being compensated by the train length if requested by trackside (see 3.11.3.1.3 for SSP, 3.11.4.6 for ASP and 3.11.5.3 for TSR). To do so, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board shall continuously compute the MRSP current speed (V_MRSP), which is the lowest speed of the MRSP elements encountered between the min safe front end and the max safe front end of the train.

requirements.reference_note: Dropped 17 steps: optional Train Data/display requests, JRU recordings, the brake intervention symbol, and the return to normal status/brake release when speed falls back below the maximum train speed (ceiling supervision, 3.13.10, not stated by the requirement). Clause 3.11.8.1 itself only states a capability; the observable outcomes come from supervising the maximum train speed as part of the MRSP (3.11.2.2 d), 3.13.2.2.13, 3.13.7.2).

support_passages.text: 3.11.11.3 The speed restriction shall be calculated when the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment receives the permitted braking distance information from trackside, and shall be re- calculated only if any of the inputs taken into account for the calculation of the speed restriction changes.

• The safe deceleration shall be computed as in 3.13.6.2.1 but without considering the adhesion profiles, the track conditions related to brake inhibition and the track conditions related to powerless section given by trackside. • The expected deceleration shall be computed as in 3.13.6.3.1 but without considering the track conditions related to brake inhibition and the track conditions related to powerless section given by trackside. • The ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall calculate an Emergency Brake Deceleration (EBD) curve based on the safe deceleration and that reaches zero speed at a distance equal to the permitted braking distance.

3.11.11.6 If the permitted braking distance is to be achieved with the emergency brake, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall seek the PBD speed restriction value (V_PBD) which satisfies the two following inequalities. The resulting value shall then be rounded down to the next lower multiple of 5km/h: 𝐴𝐵𝑆{(𝑉𝑃𝐵𝐷 + 𝑑𝑉𝑒𝑏𝑖 ) − (𝑉𝐸𝐵𝐷 (𝑑𝑜𝑓𝑓𝑠𝑒𝑡 + 𝐷𝑏𝑒𝑐 ) − 𝑉𝑑𝑒𝑙𝑡𝑎0𝑃𝐵𝐷 )} ≤ 1𝑘𝑚/ℎ 𝑑𝑜𝑓𝑓𝑠𝑒𝑡 + 𝐷𝑏𝑒𝑐 ≤ 𝑑𝑃𝐵𝐷 With 𝑑𝑉𝑒𝑏𝑖 as defined in 3.13.9.2.3 by substituting 𝑉𝑀𝑅𝑆𝑃 with 𝑉𝑃𝐵𝐷 With 𝑉𝑑𝑒𝑙𝑡𝑎0𝑃𝐵𝐷 = 𝑓41 (𝑉𝑃𝐵𝐷 + 𝑑𝑉𝑒𝑏𝑖 ) or 𝑉𝑑𝑒𝑙𝑡𝑎0𝑃𝐵𝐷 = 0 (if compensation of speed inaccuracy is inhibited by National Value)

3.13.6.2.1.4 A_brake_safe(V,d) shall be the safe emergency brake deceleration. A_brake_safe(V,d) shall be equal to: If the speed dependent deceleration model(s) for the emergency brake are acquired as part of Train Data: A_brake_safe(V,d) = Kdry_rst(V, M_NVEBCL) * (Kwet_rst(V) + M_NVAVADH *(1- Kwet_rst(V))) * A_brake_emergency(V,d)

requirements.reference_note: One test case (3111100/TC3), tagged 3.11.11.3, 3.11.11.4 d) and 3.11.11.6. Dropped 13 steps: OS driver request for speed display and JRU (1-2), JRU records (4, 6, 8, 10, 13, 15, 17), L2 LRBG balise passage (7: setup), target speed display before the restriction (9: 3.13), and end of the restriction (18-19: non-continuous profile end, 3.11.11.2); step 5 (L2 variant of step 3) is folded into the action. requirements.text: When computing the speed restriction to ensure permitted braking distance, the OBU shall apply the calculation assumptions of SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4: rotating-mass-compensated gradient, decelerations ignoring trackside adhesion profiles (safe only) and brake-inhibition/powerless-section track conditions, an EBD curve (plus an SBD curve for a service-brake PBD) reaching zero speed at the permitted braking distance, zero estimated acceleration, and fixed speed-inaccuracy, processing-delay, brake-feedback and traction cut-off assumptions.

support_passages.text: 3.11.11.4 The calculation of the speed restriction by the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall take into account that: • The single gradient value received from trackside shall be compensated in value according to the rotating mass as defined in 3.13.4.3. • The safe deceleration shall be computed as in 3.13.6.2.1 but without considering the adhesion profiles, the track conditions related to brake inhibition and the track conditions related to powerless section given by trackside. • The expected deceleration shall be computed as in 3.13.6.3.1 but without considering the track conditions related to brake inhibition and the track conditions related to powerless section given by trackside.

• The ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall calculate an Emergency Brake Deceleration (EBD) curve based on the safe deceleration and that reaches zero speed at a distance equal to the permitted braking distance.

• The estimated acceleration shall be set to “zero”. • If not inhibited by National Value, the compensation of the inaccuracy of the speed measurement shall be set to a value calculated from the PBD speed, as defined in SUBSET-041 § 5.3.1.2: V_delta0PBD = f41(V_PBD + dV_EBI(V_PBD)) if the permitted braking distance is to be achieved with the emergency brake; V_delta0PBD = f41(V_PBD + dV_SBI(V_PBD)) if the permitted braking distance is to be achieved with the service brake. • The train will travel a distance from the last encountered balise of a group that provides restrictive information until initiating the brake command. This travelled distance shall be set to a value calculated from the PBD speed considering a processing delay (T41) equal to SUBSET-041 § 5.2.1.1.

3.11.11.2 The order shall be given by means of a non-continuous profile defining: • The start and end location for the speed restriction • The permitted braking distance (PBD) used to calculate the speed restriction value • Whether the permitted braking distance is to be achieved with the Service Brake or Emergency Brake • A single gradient value applicable for the calculation 3.11.11.3 The speed restriction shall be calculated when the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment receives the permitted braking distance information from trackside, and shall be re- calculated only if any of the inputs taken into account for the calculation of the speed restriction changes.

3.11.11.6 If the permitted braking distance is to be achieved with the emergency brake, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall seek the PBD speed restriction value (V_PBD) which satisfies the two following inequalities. The resulting value shall then be rounded down to the next lower multiple of 5km/h: 𝐴𝐵𝑆{(𝑉𝑃𝐵𝐷 + 𝑑𝑉𝑒𝑏𝑖 ) − (𝑉𝐸𝐵𝐷 (𝑑𝑜𝑓𝑓𝑠𝑒𝑡 + 𝐷𝑏𝑒𝑐 ) − 𝑉𝑑𝑒𝑙𝑡𝑎0𝑃𝐵𝐷 )} ≤ 1𝑘𝑚/ℎ 𝑑𝑜𝑓𝑓𝑠𝑒𝑡 + 𝐷𝑏𝑒𝑐 ≤ 𝑑𝑃𝐵𝐷

5.2.1.1 Delay between receiving of a balise message and applying the emergency brake Description delay between receiving of a balise message and applying the emergency brake Start Event The reference mark of the on-board antenna leaving the “side lobe zone” of the last balise in the group (1.3 m from the reference mark of the balise) Stop Event Beginning of issuing of the braking order on the TIU-train interface Value < 1 sec Notes It is assumed that the activation of the emergency brake is required by the message contained in the balise group.

support_passages.text: 3.12.3.1.9 The following data shall be included in a text message: • Class of message (auxiliary or important information) • Plain text message or fixed message number • Condition for start of indication • Condition for end of indication • If driver acknowledgement is requested or not 3.12.3.1.10 The appearance of a message shall depend on the class and on whether a driver acknowledgement is requested.

8.2.3.4.7 The following applies to text messages that do not have to be acknowledged: a) The text messages shall be divided into two groups. The first group shall contain the system status messages and the important plain/fixed text messages received from trackside. The second group shall contain the auxiliary plain/fixed text messages received from trackside. b) The text messages of the first group shall be displayed above the text messages of the second group. c) The text messages of the first group shall be presented with characters in bold style. The text messages of the second group shall be presented with characters in regular style. d) The text messages belonging to the same group shall be classified in a chronological way; the newest text message being displayed on top of the group.

8.2.3.4.8 The following applies only to text messages to be acknowledged regardless of the group they belong to: a) A text message to be acknowledged shall be presented alone (see Figure 63) (the other messages that do not have to be acknowledged are temporarily not shown) in the E5-E9 (touch screen technology) or E5-E8 (soft key technology) area. b) As long as an Ack is required, the requirements specified in 5.4 shall apply on the full area formed by E5-E9 (touch screen technology) or E5-E8 (soft key technology); E10 and E11 shall show respectively the symbols NA15 and NA16. c) After acknowledgement and if the acknowledgement does not lead to the end of display, the corresponding text message shall be managed as a text message that do not have to be acknowledged but without playing the sound Sinfo.
